name: 54Th Street Southwest Tortilla Wraps
instructions: Drain all liquid from a jar of jalapeos into a medium bowl
Marinate bacon in the jalapeo juice for 30 minutes
Refill jalapeo jar with water
Remove 1 / 3 to 1 / 2 of chipotle chiles in adobo sauce and place on cutting board
Dice into fine pieces
Mix diced chiles and sauce with ranch dressing in a medium bowl
Taste
If more spiciness is desired , dice more chiles and add to dressing
Set aside
Remove bacon from jalapeo juice and discard juice
Cook bacon in large skillet until crispy enough to crumble
Do not burn ! remove bacon from skillet and place on paper towels to collect excess grease
Let cool , then crumble into bacon bit size pieces
Set aside
Cook cubed chicken breast in skillet with bacon grease until done
Discard grease
Set chicken aside
Wash romaine lettuce heads and chop until lettuce pieces are no larger than approximately one square inch
In large bowl , toss chopped romaine lettuce , parmesan cheese , cheddar cheese , bacon , chicken , and tortilla strips
Add as much chipotle ranch dressing as desired to salad mixture and toss until evenly coated
Place salad mixture onto tortillas and roll into wraps
If desired , use two toothpicks to hold wraps together and use a knife to slice wraps diagonally
Serve !
